items: Uh oh! This page does not exist... (heading+text)
icon-list: company page moved / page moved / URL incorrect
If you believe this is in error... text

proposed_rules.trigger: A page whose main heading is a 404/'this page does not exist' style message with a short list of possible causes and no other page content.
proposed_rules.decision: Model the entire body as default-content (heading, intro paragraph, a 3-row icon-list block, closing paragraph); do not create a dedicated 'error-page' block since the copy is unique, one-off content. Rejected alternative: authoring a reusable 'error-page' block template.
proposed_rules.rationale: This is a single special-purpose page (redirect/404), not a repeating pattern needing a block abstraction.

provenance.evidence: C112 whole page-12 redirect tree: rc1c2c1..rc1c2c4

notes: Simple one-off 404/redirect page; the only reusable block is the small reasons icon-list.
